official.description_text:
Postdoc in AI Agents for Life Science
Login and apply
KTH Royal Institute of Technology, School of Engineering Sciences
Job description
The AICell Lab (https://aicell.io) in the department of Applied Physics at KTH and Science for Life Laboratory is a research group funded by the
Data-driven Life Science Fellows program
. The group, led by Wei Ouyang, focuses on building AI systems for data-driven cell and molecular biology.
We are seeking a postdoctoral researcher to join our interdisciplinary team and develop innovative AI systems for scientific research and collaboration. The project contributes to a European Union-supported initiative to facilitate access to research infrastructures, particularly within the Euro-BioImaging network, while exploring broader applications of AI agents, collaborative AI systems, and AI-driven scientific discovery in life sciences.
You will contribute to the development and evaluation of AI-powered research assistants and multi-agent systems that support scientific workflows, connect researchers with expertise and infrastructure, and facilitate interdisciplinary collaboration. The role combines independent research with project coordination, scientific communication, and close collaboration with researchers, engineers, and European research infrastructure partners.
We offer collaboration opportunities with leading research institutions and universities in Europe and the US, learning and thriving in a young and ambitious research group
Qualifications
Requirements
A doctoral degree or an equivalent foreign degree. This eligibility requirement must be met no later than the time the employment decision is made.
The ability to express yourself in English, as we work in an international environment.
Preferred qualifications
A doctoral degree or an equivalent foreign degree, obtained within the last three years prior to the application deadline
Have a strong interest in scientific research, particularly in life sciences, artificial intelligence, or interdisciplinary research.
Have experience or familiarity with scientific data analysis, computational methods, or research workflows in life sciences.
Demonstrate interest or experience in AI technologies, including machine learning, large language models, or AI agents for scientific applications.
Have strong analytical, conceptual, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to translate complex scientific challenges into practical solutions.
Demonstrate excellent communication, organizational, and project management skills, including the ability to coordinate activities and collaborate with diverse stakeholders.
Are comfortable working independently and in interdisciplinary, international teams, with a proactive and collaborative approach.
Have experience or interest in user-centered design, intuitive user interfaces (UI/UX), interactive applications, or game design, with the ability to create engaging and accessible experiences for scientific users.
Have strong teaching abilities.
Have awareness of diversity and equal opportunity issues, with specific focus on gender equality.
Great emphasis will be placed on personal skills.
Join us at KTH
KTH shapes the future through education, research and innovation. As a leading international technical university, we play an active role in advancing the transition towards a sustainable society. At KTH, you have the opportunity to grow and develop in a creative and dynamic environment, with good working conditions and attractive benefits. Equality, diversity and equal opportunities are essential to quality and form an integral part of KTH’s core values as a university and public authority.
Learn more about our benefits and what it's like to work and grow at KTH.
Trade union representatives

To apply for the position
Log into KTH's recruitment system to apply for this position. You are responsible for ensuring that your application is complete according to the instructions in the ad.
The application must include:
CV including relevant professional experience and knowledge.
Copy of diplomas and grades from your previous university studies. Translations into English or Swedish if the original documents have not been issued in any of these languages.
Brief account of why you want to conduct research, your academic interests and how they relate to your previous studies and future goals. Maximally two pages long.
Your complete application must be received at KTH no later than the last day of application, midnight CET/CEST (Central European Time/Central European Summer Time).
About the employment
The position offered is for, at the most, two years.
A
position as a postdoctoral fellow
is a time-limited qualified appointment focusing mainly on research, intended as a first career step after a dissertation.

ai.summary: A postdoc position at KTH's AICell Lab developing AI systems (agents, collaborative AI, LLMs) for scientific research and discovery in life sciences, funded by the Data-driven Life Science Fellows program. The role combines research, project coordination, and collaboration with European research infrastructure partners.

thematic_fit.rationale: Limited thematic alignment. The position targets life-science applications (cell and molecular biology, Euro-BioImaging) rather than immersive systems or spatial understanding. The researcher's domains (spatial cognition, wayfinding, collaborative immersion, gamification) do not intersect with computational biology workflows. However, the emphasis on collaborative AI systems and multi-agent coordination introduces a tangential connection to the researcher's multiplayer-collaboration expertise.

methodological_fit.rationale: Moderate methodological overlap. The position explicitly values user-centred design, UI/UX, interactive applications, and collaborative systems—methodologies the researcher has practised in user studies and multiplayer-immersive design. The research involves scientific workflow support and interdisciplinary collaboration, both of which align with the researcher's experimental-design and user-study experience. However, the core deliverables (AI agents, LLMs, multi-agent systems) sit outside the researcher's current technical depth; the researcher would need to develop new competencies in LLMs and advanced AI systems.

growth_value.rationale: The postdoc would develop understanding of AI systems, LLMs, and multi-agent architectures in a real-world collaborative context. This could strengthen general research methodology and computational literacy. However, it does not close gaps in the researcher's target identity domains (spatial cognition, immersive learning, wayfinding). The researcher would gain breadth in AI-driven scientific discovery but not depth in the core capabilities needed for human-centred immersive systems research.

strategic_value.rationale: KTH is a top-tier European technical university but not listed among target institutions. Stockholm, Sweden is within preferred geography. The postdoc is temporary (max 2 years) and does not lead to a PhD pathway—a stated career goal. The position offers strong collaborative networks and access to European research infrastructure, which could build valuable connections, but the research trajectory diverges from target identity. Upon completion, the researcher would hold postdoc experience in life-sciences AI, which is not a direct stepping stone to HCI/immersive-systems PhD positions.

eligibility_flags: Posting requires a doctoral degree; researcher holds MSc by Research in progress (not yet completed).
Eligibility requirement states PhD must be held 'no later than the time the employment decision is made'—researcher must have awarded MSc before start date.
Posting strongly prefers PhD obtained within last 3 years; no relaxation for recent completions stated.
Posting is ambiguous on security clearance classification—may or may not apply to this specific position.
risks: Critical eligibility barrier: researcher does not currently hold a doctorate and must complete MSc before employment decision.

Technical gaps in Python, statistics, and LLM/AI-agent systems represent substantial ramp-up required; postdoc role emphasises independence and proactive problem-solving, reducing accommodation for learning curve.
Domain shift to life sciences is orthogonal to immersive systems; limited peer mentorship value for target identity.
Temporary contract (max 2 years) does not provide pathway continuity; researcher would need to seek another position for doctoral training.
Funding model is institutional (Data-driven Life Science Fellows), not researcher-specific; no personal funding line for independent research.
